objective: Freeze the CareOps allocation and interruption boundary against the exact pinned Kairos capabilities, distinguishing single-resource claims and bounded staged acquisition from atomic multi-resource grant.
steps: Read back the pinned Kairos request, lease, eligibility, continuation and checkpoint surfaces; retain the exact commit identity.
Review the contract through an independent agent/subagent against CC-03 and the pinned interface evidence.
Resolve reviewer findings and rerun packet/context checks; do not edit Kairos or claim atomic multi-resource grant.
Record the reviewed contract, capability limits and evidence hashes; mark A3.1 complete only after review passes.

verification.oracle: A3.1 packet structure and bounded scope pass validation.
Conductor links and plan-derived context validate after A3.1 closeout.

acceptance: Each engine lease is treated as a single-resource claim at the exact pinned Kairos commit.
CareOps staged acquisition exposes partial claims and explicit rollback; it never claims all-or-none grant.
Safe interruption requires an explicit caller-declared workpoint; urgency alone never interrupts active work.
Experimental eligibility/continuation and checkpoint limits are stated; no clinical policy or portability is inferred.
Independent reviewer-agent/subagent findings are resolved and evidence is recorded.
No Kairos source, parent pin, ED schema/default or dependency changes.
stop_conditions: True atomic multi-resource grant is required
